title: With Erskine Tate at the Metropolitan Theater
summary: He played about 1928-30 with Tate, doing legitimate presentation and silent-film background music in the pit.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah, you played with Tate then for a while.

I played with Tate at the Metropolitan Theater. What? About 1928, 29, and 30. We played, well, legitimate music, you know, besides jazz. We did presentation work in the pit. And we played background music for the pictures. It was during the silent days then. So I got pretty familiar then with the different overtures and classical numbers.
